~~~{python}
#| label: fig-minnesota-forecast-comparison
#| fig-cap: "One-month-ahead inflation forecast RMSE, 2010–2019. Smaller variance multipliers mean stronger shrinkage. The three settings are fixed in advance; lower RMSE is better."
#| code-fold: true
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

FORECAST_LAGS = 4
TIGHTNESS_VALUES = np.array([0.004, 0.04, 0.4])
CROSS_MULTIPLIER = 0.5
forecast_data_path = next(
    p for p in (Path("data"), Path("../data")) if p.exists()
)
forecast_macro = pd.read_parquet(forecast_data_path / "fred_macro_monthly.parquet")
forecast_panel = pd.DataFrame({
    "Output growth": 100 * np.log(forecast_macro["industrial_prod"]).diff(),
    "Inflation": 100 * np.log(forecast_macro["cpi"]).diff(),
    "Policy rate change": forecast_macro["fed_funds"].diff(),
}).loc["1990":"2019"].dropna()

forecast_rows = []
for forecast_date in forecast_panel.loc["2010":"2019"].index:
    history = forecast_panel.loc[forecast_panel.index < forecast_date].to_numpy()
    target = history[FORECAST_LAGS:, 1]
    design = np.column_stack(
        [np.ones(len(target))]
        + [history[FORECAST_LAGS - lag:len(history) - lag]
           for lag in range(1, FORECAST_LAGS + 1)]
    )
    next_row = np.concatenate(
        [np.ones(1)] + [history[-lag] for lag in range(1, FORECAST_LAGS + 1)]
    )
    residual_variances = np.empty(3)
    for j in range(3):
        ar_design = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(history) - 1), history[:-1, j]])
        ar_beta = np.linalg.lstsq(ar_design, history[1:, j], rcond=None)[0]
        ar_residual = history[1:, j] - ar_design @ ar_beta
        residual_variances[j] = np.mean(ar_residual**2)

    ols_beta = np.linalg.lstsq(design, target, rcond=None)[0]
    row = {
        "Date": forecast_date,
        "Actual": forecast_panel.loc[forecast_date, "Inflation"],
        "Historical mean": history[:, 1].mean(),
        "OLS VAR": next_row @ ols_beta,
    }
    for tightness in TIGHTNESS_VALUES:
        diagonal = [100 * residual_variances[1]]
        for lag in range(1, FORECAST_LAGS + 1):
            for j in range(3):
                variance = tightness / lag**2
                if j != 1:
                    variance *= CROSS_MULTIPLIER * (
                        residual_variances[1] / residual_variances[j]
                    )
                diagonal.append(variance)
        precision = (
            design.T @ design / residual_variances[1]
            + np.diag(1 / np.array(diagonal))
        )
        posterior_mean = np.linalg.solve(
            precision, design.T @ target / residual_variances[1]
        )
        row[f"Minnesota {tightness:g}"] = next_row @ posterior_mean
    forecast_rows.append(row)

forecast_results = pd.DataFrame(forecast_rows).set_index("Date")
forecast_errors = forecast_results.drop(columns="Actual").subtract(
    forecast_results["Actual"], axis=0
)
forecast_rmse = np.sqrt(forecast_errors.pow(2).mean())
minnesota_rmse = [
    forecast_rmse[f"Minnesota {tightness:g}"] for tightness in TIGHTNESS_VALUES
]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 5.4))
ax.plot(TIGHTNESS_VALUES, minnesota_rmse, color="#527a99", marker="o",
        lw=2, label="Minnesota")
ax.axhline(forecast_rmse["OLS VAR"], color="#aa8066",
           linestyle="--", label="OLS VAR")
ax.axhline(forecast_rmse["Historical mean"], color="#777777",
           linestyle=":", label="Historical mean")
ax.set(xscale="log", xticks=TIGHTNESS_VALUES,
       xticklabels=[f"{value:g}" for value in TIGHTNESS_VALUES],
       xlabel="Prior variance multiplier (stronger shrinkage ← → weaker shrinkage)",
       ylabel="Inflation forecast RMSE (percentage points)")
ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
ax.grid(False)
ax.grid(axis="y", alpha=0.3)
ax.legend(loc="upper center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.18), ncol=3, frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
print(forecast_rmse.rename("RMSE").round(4).to_string())
